input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is caused because the reset password email link uses the BASE_URL constant, which currently falls back to "http://localhost:3000" if the environment variable PUBLIC_URL is not set. This is why the links in the email point to localhost. The fix should involve ensuring the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is properly set during deployment or changes to how the base URL is derived in src/notifications/templates.ts.
